```{r}
#| label: packages
#| cache: false

library(tidyverse)
library(tidycensus)
library(janitor)
library(sf)
library(leaflet)
library(tigris)
library(RSocrata)
library(here)
library(htmltools)

options(tigris_use_cache = TRUE)
```

```{r}
#| label: evictions-2025
#| cache: true

evict_2025_raw <- read.socrata(
  "https://data.cityofnewyork.us/resource/6z8x-wfk4.json?$where=executed_date >= '2025-01-01' AND executed_date < '2026-01-01'"
)

evict_2025 <- evict_2025_raw |>
  filter(!is.na(latitude), !is.na(longitude)) |>
  mutate(
    latitude  = as.numeric(latitude),
    longitude = as.numeric(longitude)
  )
```

```{r}
#| label: rent-burden-tracts
#| cache: true

nyc_county_names <- c("Bronx", "Kings", "New York", "Queens", "Richmond")

rentburden_tracts <- get_acs(
  geography = "tract",
  table     = "B25070",
  year      = 2023,
  survey    = "acs5",
  state     = "NY",
  county    = nyc_county_names,
  geometry  = TRUE,
  output    = "wide"
) |>
  janitor::clean_names() |>
  select(geoid, ends_with("e"), geometry) |>
  mutate(
    rent_burden = if_else(
      (b25070_001e - b25070_011e) > 0,
      (b25070_007e + b25070_008e + b25070_009e + b25070_010e) /
        (b25070_001e - b25070_011e),
      NA_real_
    )
  ) |>
  select(geoid, rent_burden, geometry) |>
  st_transform(crs = 4326)
```

```{r}
#| label: county-boundaries
#| cache: true

nyc_counties_fips <- c("005", "047", "061", "081", "085")

counties <- counties(state = "NY", cb = TRUE, year = 2022) |>
  janitor::clean_names() |>
  filter(countyfp %in% nyc_counties_fips) |>
  st_transform(crs = 4326)
```

```{r}
#| label: spatial-join
#| cache: true
#| dependson: c("evictions-2025", "rent-burden-tracts")

evict_sf <- evict_2025 |>
  st_as_sf(coords = c("longitude", "latitude"), crs = 4326)

evict_sf <- st_join(
  evict_sf,
  rentburden_tracts |> select(geoid, rent_burden),
  join = st_within
)
```

```{r}
#| label: map
#| cache: false

pal_rent_burden <- colorNumeric(
  palette  = "YlOrRd",
  domain   = range(evict_sf$rent_burden, na.rm = TRUE),
  na.color = "#AAAAAA"
)

map <- leaflet(options = leafletOptions(zoomControl = TRUE)) |>
  addProviderTiles(providers$CartoDB.Positron) |>
  addCircleMarkers(
    data        = evict_sf,
    radius      = 2.5,
    color       = ~pal_rent_burden(rent_burden),
    fillColor   = ~pal_rent_burden(rent_burden),
    fillOpacity = 0.8,
    stroke      = FALSE,
    label       = ~lapply(
      paste0(
        "<b>Eviction date:</b> ", format(as.Date(executed_date), "%B %d, %Y"), "<br>",
        "<b>Tract rent burden:</b> ", scales::percent(rent_burden, accuracy = 1)
      ),
      htmltools::HTML
    )
  ) |>
  addLegend(
    position  = "bottomright",
    pal       = pal_rent_burden,
    values    = evict_sf$rent_burden,
    title     = "Rent Burden<br><small>Percent of renters paying >30%<br>of income on rent (2023)</small>",
    labFormat = labelFormat(
      suffix    = "%",
      transform = function(x) round(x * 100, 0)
    ),
    opacity   = 1
  )

div(id = "map-container", map)
```
